Strong ionicity and deep O 2p valence band place oxides high on the electronegativity ladder.
Covalent metalloid networks are canonical narrow-gap semiconductors; this is a domain prior, not a source inversion.
Partially filled d bands place states near the Fermi level; source confidence here was near zero.

skill.hypothesis: Ranks by cation-anion electronegativity difference and downweights the near-zero-confidence transition-metal source relation. Fails for d0 transition-metal oxides and defect-dominated samples where measured gaps depart from ionicity ordering.
